title: Eligibility Rules
prompt: Implement `int can_rent_car(int age, int license_years)`: eligible when age >= 21 AND license_years >= 1; a driver under 21 is never eligible, no matter the years. Return 1/0.

tests.name: young no license
tests.hint: Under 25 needs at least 1 license year.

tests.name: young with license
tests.hint: age >= 21 && license_years >= 1 — one year is enough.
